evaluation_principles: Only first-edition documentary provenance is established, not any efficacy in human life
Freeze forecast event, time window, direction tolerance, conditional circumstances, null base rate and no-prediction category before revealing person outcomes
Do not allow one broad money/reputation/health/family narrative to count simultaneously for multiple outcomes
Use negative/contradictory source claims and missed forecasts, including confidence penalties and activity/age/class baselines
Compare independent charts and same-person shuffled birthdays with matched age, class, geography, seasonality and natal ephemeris constraints
Clinical or personal safety decisions shall not use these unsupported period predictions
